reason: I already take Toplux and reorder when it runs out, and it works for me. $29.99 is more than Toplux at $23 or Goli at $19, so I have no reason to switch.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I would be paying extra for something I don't need to change.
would_change_my_mind: A price at or under what I pay now, around $20, plus a free sample box I could try on my work trips before dropping Toplux.
